name: labmeeting
description: Lab-meeting debate for biology research questions: 3 viewpoint-locked students (support / oppose / alternative) research in parallel, a postdoc triages agenda vs parked ideas and guards feasibility, and a search-less professor intervenes only when needed. Every claim is tagged [EST]/[CONTESTED]/[INFER]/[SPEC], every PMID/DOI is verified, and the minutes preserve dissent instead of picking a winner. Forked from dyubero/conclave; built on the Workflow tool.
